# Flood insurance data

> Per-county NFIP flood-insurance statistics from public FEMA data: what policyholders pay, the gap to FEMA's full-risk price, claims history, flood risk, and CRS discounts.

## States
- [District of Columbia](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-insurance/district-of-columbia/): median $384
